svg.title: CC3200 Chime UART contact points
svg.desc: CC3200 UART access points verified by continuity. Device RX is J2 hole 4 from the left and device TX is J2 hole 5. SOP2 is at H3 on the left. Reset and ground are the last two small holes at the bottom right. Verify continuity on each board.
svg.text: Verify continuity on your board. UART: 3.3 V logic. Board power: external 5 V DC.
